purpose: Curated Greater Boston continuing-care/life-plan campus search seed; seven supported options, not an exhaustive directory or recommendation.
search_rules: Treat each record as a campus, not a duplicate nursing-home or assisted-living license.
Do not attach CMS stars, staffing, inspection findings or penalties to a campus. Follow relatedUnits to the separately scoped unit record.
Five campuses have supported points. Two have null points and must be excluded from radius calculations or shown separately as city/ZIP matches with distance unavailable.
Advertised care levels, current availability, transfer rights, affordability and care suitability are different questions. Provider service descriptions are claims, not verified capacity.
CCRC directory inclusion does not mean every campus uses a lifetime fixed-price/Lifecare contract or guarantees all care on site.
